The '''Decimator Production Yards''' were [[Factory/Legends|factories]] on [[Krant]], producing [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator war machines]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The yards were destroyed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces during a [[Battle of Krant|battle]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="GB:CC" />
